categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of coatings and paints, including architectural coatings, marine coatings, fireproof coatings, heavy anti-corrosion coatings, and specialty coatings. It also engages in coating engineering services. The business segments are divided into coatings (95.04% of revenue) and coating engineering (4.96%).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced production lines with imported high-performance equipment and precision instruments for quality control and process improvement. It emphasizes R&D in water-based, inorganic, low-VOC, and functional coatings such as heat-resistant, anti-fouling, fireproof, and energy-saving paints. Automation and barcode systems are being introduced to enhance production efficiency and delivery accuracy.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries such as steel manufacturing, shipbuilding, machinery, furniture, construction, automotive, and electrical appliances. The company serves both industrial and consumer markets, with a strong presence in Taiwan and expanding overseas markets. Major customers include large steel companies and industrial manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with multiple sales offices nationwide and manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung. It has overseas production bases in China (Kunshan, Jiaxing), Vietnam, Malaysia, and the United States (California, Texas, Chicago), enabling local supply and trade tariff mitigation.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer of coatings and paints, sourcing raw materials such as resins, pigments, solvents, additives, and fillers from upstream chemical suppliers. It supplies finished products and coating services downstream to various industrial and construction sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing environmentally friendly, low-carbon, and high-performance coatings such as water-based, anti-fouling, fireproof, and energy-saving products. The company focuses on automation, digital marketing, ESG sustainability, carbon footprint management, and expanding overseas operations. R&D efforts target new product development aligned with climate change and green building standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of coatings and paints and provision of coating engineering services. The company also benefits from overseas subsidiaries and investments. Marketing efforts include sponsorships and digital media campaigns to enhance brand recognition and customer engagement.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading coatings manufacturer in Taiwan with a strong brand and comprehensive product line. It faces intense competition from numerous small and medium-sized enterprises and large multinational coating groups. Its competitive edge lies in product quality, R&D capabilities, automation, and extensive distribution channels.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$9.53 billion, a 1.83% increase from the prior year, with net profit of NT$856 million and EPS of NT$5.28. The company maintains a strong financial structure with low debt ratio (~13.35%) and steady profitability. Sales volume is projected to grow by about 7.9% in the coming year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and environmentally friendly coatings that meet international standards and certifications. It differentiates through advanced R&D, broad product variety, automation in production, and strong customer service including customized color matching. Commitment to sustainability and ESG practices further enhances its market position.
